name: Discovery
summary: Answer a question about how the system actually works, across repos, with citations.
when: You need to understand something before deciding anything — no code changes expected.
fanOutHint: One repo or subsystem per line — each gets its own agent.

stages.name: Pin the questions
stages.instruction: Turn the goal into the specific questions that have to be answered, in the order they unblock each other.

stages.name: Trace the code
stages.instruction: Answer each question from the code itself. Cite file and line for every claim. Where the code contradicts the documentation, say which one you trust and why.

stages.name: Write it up
stages.instruction: Write the findings: the answers, the parts that are still uncertain, and the decisions they unblock. Keep every claim traceable to a file.
